wing_name: Log Clearing After an Admin Sign-in (Behaviour)
description: One person signs in with administrator rights and then erases an event log within the hour. UBA rules: privileged_logon (Security 4672, the account's own SID; summarised per hour and timed at the first sign-in of that hour) then log_cleared (Security 1102, SubjectUserSid). System 104 erasures name no account, so they are machine events and cannot complete a person's set.
proves: The same account signed in with administrator rights and then erased an event log
author: Crow-Eye Team
